```{ojs}
classifier = {
  const classifier = knnClassifier.create();
  for (let i = 0; i < mnistData.X.length; i++) {
    const inputTensor = tf.tensor(mnistData.X[i], [784]);
    const label = mnistData.y[i];
    classifier.addExample(inputTensor, label);
    inputTensor.dispose();
    if(i%100 == 0 ) {
      await Promises.delay(0);
    }
  }
 return classifier;
};
mnistData = await (
  await (
    await FileAttachment("./components/mnist_train_data.json.zip").zip()
  ).file("mnist_train_data.json")
).json()
```
